name: Ingmarsö
description: Ingmarsö is an easy SAT island section linking the ferry quays at Norra and Södra Ingmarsö with the service hub, Femsundsbadet, forest and pasture paths, Kålgårdsön nature reserve and the rowboat connection toward Finnhamn. Present it as a flexible local loop/connector: accessible gravel-road variants cover much of the inhabited island, while the Femsundsbadet and Kålgårdsön trail sections add wet forest, pasture gates, boardwalks and more technical ground.
utilities: SAT step guide says open toilet and water are available at Ingmarsö Gästhamn, not in winter.

Iteration 4 operator pass found Ingmarsö Gästhamn service house open April-October in 2026, with code/call access when unstaffed; keep toilet/water seasonal and caveated rather than public year-round.

Guest-harbor toilets, showers, sauna, water, power, washing machine, grill and waste sorting are partly harbor/paid-service context. Expose only hiker-relevant seasonal toilet/water unless the app supports marina services.
Coop Ingmarsö is the strongest year-round resupply point, with staffed and unstaffed/app-based shopping patterns; exact current access/hours should be checked against operator sources.

Ingmarsö Krog and Ingmarsö Bageri/Brödboden have useful 2026 operator schedules, but store them only as dated/seasonal notes if the final schema supports that. They should remain food facilities with check-current caveats.
No confirmed campsite, hiker shelter/wind shelter or public laundry facility should be exposed for the SAT section after iteration 1.
waterSources: Primary candidate: seasonal guest-harbor water at Ingmarsö Gästhamn, supported by SAT step guide and harbor sources; not in winter and not guaranteed free year-round hiker water. Iteration 2 tightened the likely water coordinate to [59.4663125, 18.7542120].
No reliable Kålgårdsön/Femsundsbadet public water source was confirmed in iteration 1.
Carry water if hiking outside service season or continuing toward Kålgårdsön/rowboats.
notes: Route shape: lollipop / branched island route between Norra Ingmarsö, Södra Ingmarsö, Femsundsbadet and the Kålgårdsön rowboat landing.
Use current SAT page values for visible section summary after iteration 1, but retain the distance/difficulty conflict with V26 and secondary sources.
SAT says the Ingmarsö route was updated on 2025-07-18 and marked correctly on site; older Båtluffarleden/local maps/blogs are context only.
Do not follow the Södra Ingmarsö waterfront into the commercial boatyard; SAT calls this dangerous and routes hikers via the gravel road.
Close all pasture gates, keep dogs leashed where required and stay on the marked trail around grazing animals.
Kålgårdsön nature reserve requires dogs to be leashed and forbids tenting except at any designated places; no designated campsite was found in iteration 1.
Respect fire bans and do not light fires on rocks. Do not expose Bockviken firepit as a SAT facility even though off-route out-harbor sources corroborate a prepared grill place.
Most of Ingmarsö can be experienced on gravel roads, but the full SAT section is not fully accessible; avoid sections north/east of Femsundsbadet for stroller, wheelchair or limited mobility.
Plan ferry connections live and account for request/booking stops, ticket validity and pier semaphore use. Do not present ordinary SL-ticket validity to Ingmarsö as guaranteed.
If continuing to Finnhamn, check rowboat status and weather; rowboats are for connector crossing only and one boat must remain on each side.
Tick/TBE awareness is relevant in season in Stockholm/Österåker coastal areas.
Bike rental exists at the guest harbor in season, but price sources conflict; keep as note-only unless the app has paid rental/service layers.

Current service checks in iteration 2 support Coop as year-round staffed plus unstaffed/hybrid resupply, Ingmarsö Krog and Ingmarsö Bageri as stable seasonal food nodes, and Norrgården/B&B as booking-dependent accommodation/heritage context.

Norrgården service house/toilet/shower/tent-place has strong planned/funded evidence for 2024-2026 and target completion before summer 2026, but the final iteration 5 check found no source confirming it open as of 2026-04-26.
Edö Båttaxi should stay suppressed until active again; Rederi Gällnö, Gula Båten and possibly Finnhamns Sjötaxi can be note-only private fallback candidates.
Do not expose 9.8 km in normal user-facing route surfaces. Use 9.4 km from V26 geometry and retain 9.8 only in source-conflict metadata.

Bockviken/Lilla Kastet is a nearby out-harbor and bathing-rock area off the current V26 SAT line; do not rely on toilets, waste, firepit or picnic tables there as SAT facilities. TBK 2026 material says trash handling has been removed.
TrailFacility schema does not currently allow shop, accommodation or rental. Coop is modeled as food/resupply; B&B stays heritage/POI context; bike rental stays note-only.
